About the salon

A star spot on South Virginia

Hollywood Nails is a nail salon at 4930 S Virginia St in Reno. Come in for a manicure or pedicure, keep your color with gel or dip powder, or add length with nail extensions.

Booking is simple: call or text the salon and they will find you a time.
